Maria F.: Flagging unexpected GPU spend on project `shared-research-2025` ~USD 12,400 this billing cycle; attached CSV export.
CostBot: Invoice CSV uploaded: s3://billing/2026/03/shared-research-2025-gpu.csv
Alex B.: Can you confirm project id + billing acct so I can run a label audit?
Maria F.: proj: shared-research-2025, billingAccount: BA-9987. Label scan shows `team` and `owner` absent.
Lee C.: That project hosted ad-hoc LLM evals last month. I thought labels were applied via terraform, but looks like drifted instances were created manually.
Priya S.: Finance can reallocate charges but we need documented owner confirmation and an approval note. Maria, can you provide daily spend breakdown for Mar 9-15?
Maria F.: Pasted daily CSV snippet — bulk spend Mar 10-13. Link to spreadsheet in the thread.
Sam G.: I pre-authorize reallocations up to $15k internally if infra confirms provenance and owner signs off. Please keep ledger entries.
Alex B.: Quick command I ran: `gcloud compute instances list --project=shared-research-2025 --filter="labels.team:*"` returned none. I'll open a PR to add an org policy to enforce `labels.team` for GPU instances.
Priya S.: Also creating a budget alert rule: trigger when untagged GPU spend > $2k/day; will route to #finance and #eng-alerts.
CostBot: Alert created: "untagged-gpu-spend-2k-day" linked to TICKET-8120
Lee C.: Confirmed the workload belonged to ml-evals squad. I'll add retrospective `owner=ml-evals` tag where possible and file the infra change to prevent recurrence.
Maria F.: Once Lee posts confirmation, I'll perform manual allocation on the March invoice and attach Sam's approval for audit trail. Keeping this thread as the record. :white_check_mark:
